Messages.Author: ORi
Messages.Body:
Can I use regenerative blood when no damage prevention is allowed? As
per card text I'd say yes because it says that the vampire can burn 1
blood to heal 2 damage points.

Can it be used to heal damage from any source (not just in combat)?
For example, Force of Will?

thanx in advance !
ORi.

Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
ORi wrote:



From card-text it seems you could use it to heal any NON-AGGRAVATED
damage, no matter the source or circumstances. So I guess your Samedi
had better go shopping for Serpentis or Daimonion if you want to take
unpreventable aggravated damage out of combat at a lower cost.

Sten During

Messages.Body:

Correct.
(Aggravated damage can't be healed by definition, which is the reason
Regenerative Blood doesn't help there).
